text:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT (sev2) - streaming-prod eu-west1 - sustained p99 latency breach (target 450ms) observed for last 12m. Paging on-call.
Priya (oncall): I'm on it, pulling up dashboards.
Priya (oncall): Current metrics: p95 ~ 180ms, p99 ~ 3.2s, error rate low but tail latency high, streaming connectors showing stalls.
Maya (sre): I see skewed scheduling and high GPU kernel time on node gpux-eu1-03 since 02:05 UTC, queue length increasing.
Omar (infra): grabbing node health + temps. Suspect thermal/power throttling or ECC. Running `nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,UTILIZATION,ERROR` and tailing system logs.
Priya (oncall): app logs show repeated corrected ECC events and occasional `GPU: GPU has fallen off the bus` warnings referencing gpux-eu1-03.
Jake (eng-runtime): runtime traces indicate KV cache miss amplification when requests routed to that node; token generation stalls with long backend waits. Fallbacks to CPU observed which inflate latency.
Priya (oncall): mitigation proposal: 1) cordon & drain gpux-eu1-03 2) shift active streaming sessions away 3) temporarily increase reroute share to healthy nodes 4) spin up reserve nodes to absorb load. Agree? :+1:
Omar (infra): executing: `kubectl cordon gpux-eu1-03 && kubectl drain gpux-eu1-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=45`
SRE-Bot: Automated routing policy increased reroute_pct from 15% to 65% for region-eu-west1 to reduce tail pressure.
Maya (sre): drain in progress, observed 6 pods stuck terminating for streaming connectors; forced delete after grace-period to prevent long stalls.
Alice (support): drafting support banner: "We're investigating intermittent streaming latency in eu-west1. Customers may see delayed responses. We'll update once mitigations are complete."
Omar (infra): hardware telemetry: GPU core temps ~ 95C sustained, fans at 100%, power cap events seen. `dmesg` shows repeated `Corrected ECC` messages at high frequency.
Jake (eng-runtime): runtime snippet:
```
[02:06:18] kv_cache.lookup id=0x7a2 latency=142ms node=gpux-eu1-03
[02:06:19] generate.token stall backend_wait=2.3s fallback=cpu
```
Priya (oncall): provisioning two reserve nodes (gpux-eu1-08, gpux-eu1-09) from dedicated reserve pool. Omar, can you confirm quick attach?
Omar (infra): confirmed, nodes provisioned and joined runtime pool in ~4m.
Maya (sre): after traffic redistribution, p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 620ms within 6 minutes. Still above SLO but improving trend.
Priya (oncall): customer impact estimate: about 3-6% of streaming requests in eu-west1 experienced tail > SLO, primarily tail latency spikes not request loss. No major customer-facing failures detected.
Omar (infra): uploaded hardware logs and `nvidia-smi` captures to INF-6220, and opened HW ticket for potential RMA if ECC frequency persists.
Jake (eng-runtime): deployed quick runtime change: reduce max-concurrency for newly scheduled streaming pods and increase KV cache replication factor for hot keys to reduce single-node hotness. Monitoring for regressions.
Priya (oncall): SUMMARY for handoff: suspected thermal-induced ECC flake on gpux-eu1-03 causing intermittent corrected errors and partial GPU disconnects -> KV cache stalls and fallback to CPU -> p99 tail spike. ACTIONS TAKEN: cordoned/drained node, forced delete for stuck pods, bumped routing reroute_pct, provisioned reserve nodes, runtime concurrency/replication adjustments, support banner posted. CURRENT: p99 trending down (620ms -> 360ms) after redistribution.
Priya (oncall): ACTION ITEMS:
- Omar: full hardware triage, extract long-term telemetry, decide on RMA for gpux-eu1-03 if ECC events continue. (INF-6220)
- Maya: run soak tests on new nodes with streaming connectors and validate no regression; verify pod churn handled gracefully.
- Jake: follow up with a durable KV cache replication change and add per-node retry throttles to avoid cascading stalls.
- Alice: continue customer comms, update ticket INC-23900 with ETA for full resolution and postmortem link.
SRE-Bot: Handoff reminder in 30m to #eng-oncall. Incident marked active and assigned to Priya for monitoring.
Maya (sre): p99 now at 360ms after further smoothing and cache replication. Monitoring for 30m before closure.
Priya (oncall): final note at 02:40 UTC - no additional ECC spikes on other nodes; single node gpux-eu1-03 shows persistent corrected ECC frequency -> hardware flagged for replacement. Marking last_message.
SRE-Bot: Incident logged -> INC-23900 | severity downgraded to sev3 at 02:45 UTC. Please ensure follow-up tasks added to the postmortem doc and HW ticket.
Alice (support): scheduling cross-team postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will circulate meeting invite and draft incident timeline. Thanks everyone. :pray:
